question: Why does the speaker claim inability to fully describe the sixteen-syllabled Śrīvidyā?
premises: The speaker refers to the sixteen-syllabled Śrīvidyā.
Describing it is declared not possible.
The speaker personally affirms this limitation.
inference: The sixteen-syllabled Śrīvidyā is held to be beyond the speaker's capacity to describe.
plain_english: I am indeed not able to describe the sixteen-syllabled Śrīvidyā.
